.eslintrc.json.name: Code style rules
.eslintrc.json.description: Sets the automatic code-quality rules that flag common mistakes before they reach the live site.

.npmrc.name: Package manager settings
.npmrc.description: Tells the package installer how to behave when adding or updating the site's software dependencies.

.nvmrc.name: Node version pin
.nvmrc.description: Locks the version of Node.js so every developer and the hosting service run the exact same one.

next.config.mjs.name: Site build settings
next.config.mjs.description: Configures how the website is built and which image sources, redirects, and optimisations are enabled.

package.json.name: Project manifest
package.json.description: Lists every software dependency the site needs and the commands to build, start, and test it.

playwright.config.ts.name: Browser test settings
playwright.config.ts.description: Configures the automated browser tests — which browsers to use, timeouts, and where to find the site.

postcss.config.mjs.name: CSS processing settings
postcss.config.mjs.description: Tells the build step which CSS transformations to apply so modern styles work in all browsers.

prisma.config.ts.name: Database tool settings
prisma.config.ts.description: Points the database management tool at the correct Postgres database address.

tailwind.config.ts.name: Design system theme
tailwind.config.ts.description: Defines the brand colours, fonts, spacing, and breakpoints that keep the site's look consistent.

tsconfig.json.name: TypeScript settings
tsconfig.json.description: Configures the type-checking rules and import shortcuts used across the entire codebase.

vercel.json.name: Hosting settings
vercel.json.description: Tells Vercel how to deploy the site, including any custom headers or function limits.
